description: Lists the signed-in user's Teams notifications (the bell inbox) from the last 30 days, newest first, up to 50. Use when the user asks what's new, what they missed, or for alerts since a date. Not for setup steps (use get_onboarding_progress). Returns each notification's title, text and time.

after.description: Only notifications created after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-11-20" or "2026-11-20T09:00:00Z". Omit for the last 30 days.

name: list_notifications
title: List Teams notifications
